tips.text: Scout all three canvases before touching any paint; nothing spawns until someone picks it up.
Do canvas B first and leave canvas A in the concourse for last; the Drip, Drip, Drip ink walls choke the side rooms later.
As Operator, roll instead of walking and hold crouch mid-roll for Void Mode; sprint inside it to cross Follie's drain aura.
Set up your Operator before you farm: Unairu for knockdown immunity, Metem-Erun and Magus Cadence for speed, Magus Vigor for bulk.
Bring Hildryn or Lavos for no energy cost, or a tanky frame like Inaros, Dante, Rhino, Wisp or Kullervo.
Pop every Atramentum Balloon once Follie starts hunting; a loot radar mod shows the ones in your room.
Run it solo or with one partner who splits the canvases; public squads often ignore the objective, and solo needs only 2 paints per canvas.
Buy any part that has not dropped as soon as your Atramentum covers it.
Kill Follie's clones and Facsimile statues on sight; shooting a Facsimile shrinks its aura.
Check that your Operator is covered in purple goo before you run off; you get forced out of your frame just before the pickup.
Expect the forced-Operator mode to be the pain, not the odds; reports run from about 10 clears with good luck to around 30 Steel Path clears.
